rows.grounds: compound genitive plural denoting guru, mantra, and iṣṭadevatā as a group
abstract noun expressing identity or unity

items.question: What unity is doctrinally affirmed among guru, mantra, and chosen goddess?
premises: Guru, mantra, and chosen goddess are named together as a related set.
Oneness is predicated of this set.
This oneness is explicitly declared as a teaching.
items.inference: The guru, the mantra, and the chosen goddess are taught to be one.
items.plain_english: The oneness of the guru, the mantra, and the chosen goddess is declared.
